build_dinotxt_model: build a DINOTxt vision-language model with pretrained ViT-L/16 backbone and text transformer
build_dinotxt_untrained: build a DINOTxt model from scratch without pretrained weights using pretrained=False
build_dinotxt_custom_weights: build a DINOTxt model loading custom weights from a URL or file path
create_dinotxt_tokenizer: create a BPE tokenizer for DINOTxt text encoding using the default vocab URL
review_DINOTxtWeights: review the DINOTxtWeights enum to see available pretrained weight variants like LVTD2300M
